newsitem.title: USA: Omega sells one million shares.
newsitem.headline: Omega sells one million shares.

text.p: Omega Healthcare Investors Inc said Friday it had sold one million shares in a registered direct placement with an institutional investor.
Net proceeds will be used to repay borrowings under the company's line of credit and for general corporate purposes.
The shares were sold pursuant to Omega's effective shelf registration statement and are expected to settle on November 20, it said.
The company did not identify the institutional investor.

"Our objective is to maintain a balanced capital structure, and this reestablishes significant availability under our line of credit after drawing for third quarter investments of $54 million," Omega President Essel Bailey said in a statement.

Omega said it had about 17.1 million common shares outstanding at the end of its third quarter. Omega is a real estate investment trust investing in and providing financing to the long-term care industry.
